messages.subject: GCC Corporate Affairs Executive | Government Relations, ESG & Stakeholder Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Tarbit,

Your leadership of Taylor Birchwood's Middle East practice in Dubai, with a specialist focus on corporate affairs, public policy and senior communications talent across the region, makes this a particularly relevant introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications within a major natural-resources operation.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments where institutional trust, regulatory strategy, reputation, stakeholder engagement and responsible development must work together. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, followed by the UAE and wider GCC, and I am internationally mobile for expatriate assignments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for appropriate current or future mandates across corporate affairs, government relations, external affairs, sustainability, strategic partnerships and country leadership.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
